assets.alt_text: Close-up of brood-comb cells containing hard dark larval remains characteristic of American foulbrood scale
assets.caption: AFB adherent scale. Hard, dark larval remains can persist tightly on the lower wall of brood cells after infected material dries. The teaching photograph must be interpreted with other colony signs and current official or laboratory confirmation requirements.
